modelMetadata.name: Gemini 4 Argon
modelMetadata.descriptionZh: Google 面向复杂软件工程、科学推理与跨领域知识工作推出的 Gemini 4 模型；1M 是统一输入输出窗口，长输出需续传。
modelMetadata.descriptionEn: Google frontier Gemini 4 model for complex engineering, science and knowledge work, with a unified input/output window and continuation protocol.

summaryZh: 本批11项均已交付并接受检查。SVG的主要约束和动画连接完成得较好，书架主体尺寸、行星机构齿数与采样速比也有核查支撑；机械网格与UV、室内床体尺寸、取景和装饰细节仍有问题。四部知识片均达到1080p、78–89秒，主要解释大体成立，但NASA图表的自定分数、二维码额外断言和部分缺字符号影响可靠性。可编辑工程与源码均保留，使用前仍需核对几何、来源与细字可读性。
summaryEn: All 11 tasks were delivered and inspected. SVG constraints and animation attachments are well executed, with checks supporting the shelf bodies, gear counts and sampled ratio; mechanical meshes/UVs, bed dimensions, interior framing and decorative details still have problems. All four knowledge films reach 1080p and 78–89 seconds, with broadly sound explanations, but self-defined scores in a NASA-labeled chart, extra QR claims and missing glyphs affect reliability. Editable projects and source are retained; geometry, sources and fine-text readability still need review before use.
methodZh: creative-suite-v4：三项 Blender、四项日期锁定知识视频、三项静态 SVG 与一项 SMIL 动画。模型通过 Google Developer API 兼容工具循环独立编写源码，本地渲染生成画面；协调者只编排、检查和整理交付。未强制 thinkingLevel，文档默认 MEDIUM；未独立测定每次请求的实际思考档位。 知识片旁白统一由本地 Kokoro zf_xiaobei（lang z）合成，未评测 Gemini 原生语音生成。Blender 影片使用程序配乐与音效，无旁白。 书架和首部知识片会话遇到流式多工具调用索引碰撞：适配器将多次看图调用合并，调用未执行。保留错误与用量后，在原会话追加每次响应只调用一个工具的兼容说明，随后恢复；后续Argon案例也附同一技术说明。原冻结运行代码、任务和模型均未更换。串行调用及资源中断会影响请求次数与耗时，本批不据此作跨模型速度或成本排名。 磁盘紧张时曾改为逐项运行；空间回升到约6GiB后，继续以最多一项Blender和一部知识片并行。原有会话与作品始终保留，资源与队列时间不代表模型推理速度。 室内场景的长源码响应曾多次无有效内容断连；保留原会话后追加分段持久保存源码的技术说明，随后继续写入，底层断连原因未确定。
methodEn: creative-suite-v4: three Blender tasks, four date-locked knowledge videos, three static SVGs and one SMIL animation. The model independently authors source through the Google Developer API-compatible tool loop; local renderers generate media. The coordinator orchestrates, inspects and packages. No thinkingLevel was forced; the documented default is MEDIUM, without per-request independent measurement. Knowledge narration uses the fixed local Kokoro zf_xiaobei voice (lang z); Gemini-native speech generation was not evaluated. Blender films use procedural music and effects, without narration. The bookshelf and first knowledge-film sessions encountered colliding indices in streamed parallel tool calls: the adapter merged image-view calls, which were not executed. Errors and usage were retained; technical feedback requested one tool call per response in the original sessions, which then resumed. Subsequent Argon cases receive the same transport instruction. Frozen runtime code, tasks and model are unchanged. Serial calls and resource interruptions affect request counts and elapsed time, which are not used for cross-model speed or cost rankings. Work was queued one case at a time under disk pressure. After free space recovered to about 6 GiB, at most one Blender case and one knowledge film ran together. Existing sessions and artwork were retained; resource and queue time are not model inference speed. Long interior-source responses repeatedly disconnected without usable content. The original session resumed with technical feedback to persist source in smaller pieces; source writing then continued. The underlying disconnect cause remains undetermined.
workflowNoteZh: 画面点评由 AI 完成；尺寸、媒体和音频检查使用程序。不冒称人工评分或实际听审。accepted 表示交付和检查完成，质量问题保留在各题简评。
workflowNoteEn: Visual observations are by AI; dimensions, media and audio checks use scripts. No human scoring or actual listening is claimed. Accepted means delivery and inspection; quality defects remain in the case notes.
usageNoteZh: 原生 P/C/T、cache 和明确返回的 reasoning 逐请求保留在公开账目。C 不保证包含全部隐藏思考，缺失不是 0，不用 T−P−C 推算。完整输入/输出总量未知，展示为 —；已知小计不是完整账单。
usageNoteEn: Native P/C/T, cache and explicitly returned reasoning are retained per request in the public ledger. C is not guaranteed to include all hidden thinking; missing is not zero and T−P−C is not inferred as reasoning. Complete input/output totals are unknown and shown as —; known subtotals are not a full bill.
billingZh: API 未返回实际账单或抵扣金额，实际费用未知；未用价格估算替代账单。
billingEn: The API did not return actual charges or credit deductions. Actual monetary cost is unknown; no price estimate substitutes for billing.
limitationsZh: 不公开完整题目输入、私有续接、事件日志或隐藏思考。
源码 ZIP 是审阅文件的公开派生包：TTS 元数据脱敏及可选截图助手排除逐项列明；作品、音轨与其余作者文件字节保留。
原生工程保留作者内嵌脚本。没有完整从零复建认证，也没有人工听审认证。
模型 ID 是提供商返回的精确别名；未公布可验证的不可变 checkpoint。
limitationsEn: Full task inputs, private continuations, event logs and hidden thinking are excluded.
Source ZIPs are reviewed public derivatives: TTS metadata sanitization and optional helper exclusions are listed. Artwork, audio and other author member bytes are retained.
Native projects retain author-embedded scripts. Complete from-zero reproducibility and human listening are not certified.
Model identity is the exact returned provider alias, without a published verifiable immutable checkpoint.

assessmentZh: 两版共享参数脚本，木板主体的800/1000mm宽、300mm深、1200mm高及18mm厚度均可核对，三格376mm与四格277.5mm净高准确，抽查榫槽接口贴合。六张图清楚展示正背面与局部连接；含外露五金的总外包略超名义尺寸，浅木上的白字对比一般。
assessmentEn: The shared generator produces the specified 800/1000 mm wood-body widths, 300 mm depth, 1200 mm height and 18 mm boards. Clear bays measure 376 mm and 277.5 mm, with matching joint sections. Six clear views show both sides and local joinery. Protruding hardware slightly exceeds the nominal envelope, and white labels have limited contrast on pale wood.

assessmentZh: 浅色海岸背景中，白色鹈鹕的长橙喙和喉囊清楚，水手帽、红围巾、青绿自行车与鱼篮增加辨识度。两轮、车架、座垫与把手齐全；轮辐、链轮、可见曲柄及双腿实际运动，40个时点的臀部、膝、踝和脚踏连接均通过检查，主体始终在画布内。云、路面与围巾的移动形成骑行感；末帧到首帧变化与普通邻帧相当，循环衔接自然。
assessmentEn: Against a light coastal background, the white pelican's long orange bill and throat pouch are clear; a sailor hat, red scarf, teal bicycle and fish basket add character. Both wheels, frame, saddle and handlebar are present. Spokes, chainring, visible crank and both legs move; hip, knee, ankle and pedal attachment checks pass at all forty sampled times, with the subject remaining on canvas. Moving clouds, road and scarf convey travel. The last-to-first transition is comparable to ordinary adjacent frames and the loop looks continuous.
